verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents visa guides, consultations and client-portal questionnaires, but nothing describing a free, self-serve O-1/EB-1 eligibility checker or assessment tool on Alma's site. The homepage snippet listing 'O-1A … Recommended / EB-1A … Strong' looks like a sample result graphic. Nothing establishes it as a free, user-runnable qualifier. Guides and paid-case questionnaires are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site
